about: What an Academy booking costs (scope-v1 module 15): one seat at the individual fee, or each head of a company at the corporate fee per head. The fees come from the academy.price setting. Nothing is rounded: Academy fees are not chips, so the ₹50 rule does not apply. The setting allows at most ₹1,00,000 a seat or head, and a booking has at most 100 heads.

cases.description: One seat at the opening fee, ₹2,000.
Three heads of a company at ₹1,500 each.
No rounding to ₹50: one seat at ₹1,999.99 costs ₹1,999.99.
No rounding for a company either: three heads at ₹1,500.25 cost ₹4,500.75.
The largest booking: 100 heads at the highest fee the setting allows, ₹1,00,000 a head.
